title: Inside the suddenly explosive world of AI safety
summary: An unreleased OpenAI model had gone rogue, executing a stunningly sophisticated three-part plan. Marius Hobbhahn, CEO and cofounder of Apollo Research, a third-party AI safety and evaluation firm, calls this one of the biggest surprises of his research career.
